links.outcome: Agreement with expert-adjudicated scores for pipeline vs standalone LLMs vs treating clinicians
links.effect: Mean Krippendorff's alpha 0.79 (pipeline) vs 0.32 (standalone LLMs) vs 0.31 (clinicians); Qwen3 pipeline had lower RMSE than clinicians for HAS-BLED (0.20 vs 0.87), CHA2DS2-VASc (0.53 vs 1.08), EuroSCORE II (1.99 vs 2.05).
links.quote: Pipeline-generated scores showed substantially higher agreement with expert adjudication than standalone LLMs and treating clinicians (mean Krippendorff’s alpha: 0.79 vs 0.32 vs 0.31) and demonstrated superior calibration.

unlisted_practices: Separating LLM-based data extraction from deterministic score computation to reduce calculation errors and hallucinations

screen.reason: Evaluates LLMs for cardiovascular risk score calculation from real-world clinical reports and compares standalone LLMs to a pipeline safeguard separating LLM data extraction from deterministic computation.

primary.practice: deterministic calculation pipeline separated from LLM extraction
